column1: # Bosnian (bs) catalog, Latin script, Ijekavian. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_russian` in i18n.rs): one (1, 21, 101 ...) | few (2-4, 22-24 ..., not 12-14) | other.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Bosnian computing vocabulary (historija, sačuvaj, tačka, datoteka, postavke). No proprietary
# localisation resource, string table or product UI (Acrobat's included) was consulted or copied;
# add entries the same way. AI-assisted (Claude Code), not yet reviewed by a native speaker; the
# wording is shared with storytold/craft-i18n (locales/bs/pdfcraft.tsv and common.tsv).
# Product and technology names (PdfCraft, PDF, Acrobat JavaScript ...) are not translated;
# the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
